ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure contains two maps arranged side by side, with the left map titled “1970” and the right map titled “2000”, both showing isolines of summer maize sowing dates in some areas of China; the isolines are marked with values such as 130, 140, 150, and 160, indicating the nth day counted from January 1; the figure marks the locations of four areas ①, ②, ③, and ④. Reasoning: Compare the isoline values for the same number in the two maps of 1970 and 2000; an increase in value indicates a delayed sowing date. Near ①, the value drops from about 140 in 1970 to about 130 in 2000, so it is not delayed; near ②, the value in 2000 is not higher than in 1970, so it is not delayed; near ④, the value drops from about 150 to about 140, so it is not delayed; near ③, the isoline value in 2000 is higher than in 1970, indicating that the sowing date was delayed. Therefore, the one meeting the condition is ③.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure below illustrates isolines of summer maize sowing dates in some areas of China in 1970 and 2000.

<image1>

Read the figure and judge: Compared with 1970, in which area in the figure was the summer maize sowing date delayed in 2000? Please answer with the number.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: two maps show summer maize sowing-date isolines for the same area in 1970 and 2000, with numbered regions marked. Then read the contour value near each number in both panels. Compare the day-number value for 2000 minus 1970 at ①、②、③、④. The only numbered region whose 2000 contour value is greater than its 1970 contour value is ③, so answer with 序号3.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左右并列两幅地图，左图标题为“1970年”，右图标题为“2000年”，均表示我国部分地区夏玉米播种日期等值线；等值线标注有130、140、150、160等数值，表示以1月1日起算的第几天；图中标出①、②、③、④四个地区位置。推理：比较同一序号在1970年和2000年两幅图中的等值线数值，数值变大表示播种日期推迟。①附近由1970年的约140降到2000年的约130，未推迟；②附近2000年数值不高于1970年，未推迟；④附近由约150降到约140，未推迟；③附近2000年的等值线数值高于1970年，表示播种日期推迟。因此符合条件的是③。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: compare the 1970 and 2000 panels as two contour maps over the same geographic base. For ①、②、④, the 2000 position places them in earlier/lower-value contour belts than in 1970, so they are not delayed. For ③, the 2000 contour belt at that fixed southwestern location is a later/higher-value belt than in 1970. Therefore the delayed region is ③.

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the relative positions of the same isolines in the 1970 and 2000 panels. Observe that around regions ①、②、④ the 2000 isolines of a given date lie such that these points fall into lower day-number zones than before, whereas near the southwest numbered point ③ the relevant isoline position changes so that the point falls into a higher day-number zone in 2000.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the wording “与1970年相比，2000年……推迟” to decide that the needed judgment is whether the same place has entered a later contour belt in 2000.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For isoline maps, if a fixed site moves from a lower-value zone to a higher-value zone, the represented date is delayed. If it moves from a higher-value zone to a lower-value zone, the date is advanced. Here the values are day counts from January 1.
